newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PARLIAMENT TO VOTE ON SECURITIES LAW JUNE 6.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PARLIAMENT TO VOTE ON SECURITIES LAW JUNE 6.

text.p: The Polish Sejm, lower house, will vote on a new bill on public securities trading on Friday, a Sejm press office official said on Thursday.
The official said the vote was likely to take place at the start of Friday's session.
The bill, which adjusts Poland's law to the international standards, is expected to be passed as all parliamentary groups supported the draft in Wednesday's debate.
The bill would also need approval of the upper house of the parliament - the Senate, a decision expeted within a month and has to be signed by the president to become law.

The bill creates a legal framework for the introduction of new instruments such as futures and options, authorizes brokerages to advise their clients and makes easier issuing shares by companies already traded on the bourse.
